_comment: Pre-registered connection so pgAdmin opens on the session store instead of
an empty tree. Loaded once, on the first start with an empty pgadmin-data
volume (the container's entrypoint imports it, then never looks again) — so
editing this file after that needs `make reset` or a manual re-import.
The password is deliberately absent: pgAdmin only accepts a saved-password
file at mode 0600 owned by its own uid (5050), which a host bind mount
cannot provide. Enter it once (POSTGRES_PASSWORD, default agents_secret)
and tick Save password — that lands in the volume and persists.

1.Name: Orrery session store
1.Comment: ADK sessions, events and app/user state. The console's history reads from `sessions` + `events`.
